title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
script:
Itaú is rolling out AI to its entire customer base by late 2026.
They built a conversational interface called ia.i for customer interactions.
The bank also launched the IARA platform to manage internal AI governance.
This project integrates OpenAI technology into one of the world's most regulated sectors.
Employees now use these tools to accelerate workflows across the entire firm.
The bank is prioritizing security while deploying these systems at this massive scale.
Would you trust a bank's AI to manage your primary savings account?
